origin.description: Run a callable and return what it printed, or the message it sent.
origin.usage: capture.output(..., file = NULL, append = FALSE, type = c("output", "message"), split = FALSE)

arguments.name: expr
arguments.text: A callable, or a value to print.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: Also write the text to this path.

arguments.name: append
arguments.text: Append to file instead of replacing it.

arguments.name: split
arguments.text: Also write the text to the real stream.

origin.details: type is output or message. The check captures message("hi").
origin.example:
bp_capture.output <- getFromNamespace("capture.output", "backports")
captured <- bp_capture.output(message("hi"), type = "message")
print(captured)
